lessons: The premise finding is valid. clutch/specs/implement.md rule 5 (line 47) says: never add, edit or refresh a clutch:meta header, because Check writes headers for every file the diff changes. Scope in still tells the implementer to edit purpose lines, which the spec forbids.

Rewrite Scope in for tests/integration/test_specs_delimiter_note.py, test_implement_spec_meta_headers.py and test_implement_spec_mutation_check.py. Delete each 'edit/drop 2.27 from the purpose header' instruction and say that Check owns the purpose-line update for those changed files.

Example: tests/integration/test_implement_spec_mutation_check.py line 4 purpose ends 'and pins version 2.27'. The implementer leaves it as is. Acceptance criteria 1 and 2 grep only '"2.27"' and 'implement 2.27', so a stale purpose line does not break them.

Keep the test-body work unchanged: unit pin in test_implement_spec_consumer_read; skip implement version in delimiter-note; delete test_implement_spec_meta_header_version; drop the == "2.27" assert and the load_spec import (line 11); build the test_stages.py spec line from the loaded spec version.
